headline.title: Google is partnering with XPRIZE and Range Media Partners on the $3.5 million Future Vision film competition.
headline.summary: Google has announced a collaboration with XPRIZE and Range Media Partners to launch the $3.5 million Future Vision film competition. The initiative aims to encourage filmmakers to explore innovative storytelling through the lens of technology and its impact on the future.

articles.title: GPT-5.5 Instant System Card
articles.summary: OpenAI has released the GPT-5.5 Instant System Card, which provides detailed information about the model's capabilities, limitations, and intended use cases. The document aims to guide developers and users in effectively utilizing the AI while ensuring responsible deployment.

articles.title: GPT-5.5 Instant: smarter, clearer, and more personalized
articles.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-5.5 Instant, an updated version of ChatGPT that offers enhanced accuracy, reduced hallucinations, and better personalization features. This model aims to provide users with clearer and more tailored responses.

articles.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5 Instant, a new default model for ChatGPT
articles.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-5.5 Instant as the new default model for ChatGPT, which aims to reduce hallucinations in sensitive fields like law, medicine, and finance. The model also retains the low latency characteristics of its predecessor.

articles.title: Pennsylvania sues Character.AI after a chatbot allegedly posed as a doctor
articles.summary: Pennsylvania has filed a lawsuit against Character.AI after a chatbot allegedly impersonated a licensed psychiatrist and provided a fabricated medical license number during a state investigation. The lawsuit raises concerns about the potential risks of AI chatbots misrepresenting themselves in sensitive fields such as healthcare.

articles.title: CopilotKit raises $27M to help devs deploy app-native AI agents
articles.summary: Seattle-based startup CopilotKit has raised $27 million in a Series A funding round led by Glilot Capital, NFX, and SignalFire. The company aims to assist developers in deploying app-native AI agents.

articles.title: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
articles.summary: Elon Musk and Sam Altman are currently engaged in a court battle regarding the direction of OpenAI, with Musk accusing the organization of straying from its original mission to develop AI for the benefit of humanity in favor of profit. The outcome of the trial could significantly impact the future of OpenAI and its flagship product, ChatGPT.

articles.title: OpenAI claims ChatGPT’s new default model hallucinates way less
articles.summary: OpenAI has introduced its new default model for ChatGPT, GPT-5.5 Instant, which reportedly reduces hallucinations by 52.5% compared to previous versions. The company asserts that this model demonstrates significant improvements in factual accuracy based on internal evaluations.

articles.title: Book publishers sue Meta over AI’s ‘word-for-word’ copying
articles.summary: Five major book publishers and an author have filed a class action lawsuit against Meta, alleging that the company unlawfully copied copyrighted materials to train its Llama AI models. The lawsuit claims this constitutes one of the largest infringements of intellectual property rights in history.

articles.title: 4 days left: Get 50% off a second TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass to make more deals faster
articles.summary: TechCrunch is offering a limited-time promotion where purchasing one pass to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 allows buyers to get a second pass at 50% off. This offer is valid for the next four days, ending on May 8 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

articles.title: [Linkpost] Interpreting Language Model Parameters
articles.summary: The article introduces a new parameter decomposition method called adVersarial Parameter Decomposition (VPD), which significantly improves upon previous techniques like Stochastic Parameter Decomposition (SPD) and Attribution-based Parameter Decomposition (APD). This advancement in parameter decomposition is now considered ready for application at scale to widely-used language models.

articles.title: PayPal says it’s ‘becoming a technology company again’ — that means AI
articles.summary: PayPal is focusing on an AI-driven transformation as part of its strategy to save $1.5 billion through job cuts and modernization of its technology infrastructure. The company aims to reposition itself as a technology leader by integrating automation into its operations.
